source: (on a US layout)
translation: （美式键盘布局下）
reason: Human-readable keybinding fate suffix shown after an action description; preserves the leading separator and parenthetical qualification for a US keyboard layout.

source: (built in, not configurable)
translation: （内置，不可配置）
reason: Human-readable keybinding fate suffix explaining that the intercepted binding is built in and cannot be configured; preserves the leading separator and parenthetical qualification.

source: ); a layout without seconds refreshes once a minute
translation: ）；不含秒的格式每分钟刷新一次

source: 0 uses %d. auto uses the refresh rate of your display. The range is %d to %d.
translation: 0 使用 %d。auto 使用显示器刷新率。范围为 %d 到 %d。

source: A command that gets each copy mode yank on stdin. Its output goes to the clipboard. If this is empty, tuios copies the selection as it is.
translation: 每次在复制模式复制时，将选区通过标准输入交给此命令，再将命令输出放入剪贴板。留空则直接复制选区。

source: A new window starts in the focused pane's working directory
translation: 新窗口使用当前窗格的工作目录

source: A plain right-click on a pane in terminal mode opens the pane menu, for pasting without selecting first
translation: 终端模式下直接右键点击窗格即可打开菜单，无需先选中文字便可粘贴

source: A split or new window of a pane that runs ssh runs the same ssh
translation: 从运行 ssh 的窗格拆分或新建窗口时，使用相同的 ssh 连接

source: A value above what they can show does not make tuios smoother.
translation: 超过其显示能力的帧率不会让 tuios 更流畅。

source: After a daemon restart, ask to resume each pane's agent conversation, resume it, or do neither
translation: 守护进程重启后，询问是否继续各窗格的智能体对话、直接继续，或不作处理

source: Agents, the Inbox, mail and approvals. Turn off to keep only the multiplexer.
translation: 启用智能体、收件箱、消息和授权功能。关闭后仅保留终端复用功能。

source: Alert on a message from one agent to another agent too.
translation: 智能体之间互发消息时也提醒。

source: Alert when an agent goes quiet
translation: 智能体进入空闲状态时提醒

source: Alert when an agent reports it finished
translation: 智能体报告完成时提醒

source: Alert when an agent starts work
translation: 智能体开始工作时提醒

source: Alert when an agent stops on an error
translation: 智能体因出错而停止时提醒

source: Alert when an agent waits for you
translation: 智能体等待你回应时提醒

source: Alt plus left-drag moves a pane
translation: 按住 Alt 并用鼠标左键拖动可移动窗格

source: Always confirm on quit, not only when processes are running
translation: 每次退出时都确认，即使没有运行中的进程

source: Animate UI transitions instead of applying them instantly
translation: 界面切换时播放动画

source: Animate the screen after a spell with no input
translation: 一段时间没有输入后显示屏幕保护动画

source: BSP scheme a workspace inserts new windows with the first time it is tiled. A workspace already tiled keeps its own scheme.
translation: 工作区首次进入平铺模式时，新窗口采用的 BSP 插入方案。已平铺的工作区保留现有方案。

source: Background behind and between panes, including gaps and an empty workspace: off, theme, or a #RRGGBB literal; empty follows appearance.background
translation: 窗格背后及之间的背景，包括间隙和空工作区：off、theme 或 #RRGGBB 色值；留空则沿用 appearance.background

source: Background behind every search match
translation: 所有搜索匹配项的背景色

source: Background behind pane content: off, theme, or a #RRGGBB literal; empty follows appearance.background
translation: 窗格内容的背景：off、theme 或 #RRGGBB 色值；留空则沿用 appearance.background

source: Background behind selected text
translation: 所选文字的背景色

source: Background behind the match the cursor is on
translation: 光标所在搜索匹配项的背景色

source: Background of the copy mode cursor block
translation: 复制模式块状光标的背景色

source: Background painted on every surface not set on its own (panes, desktop, window chrome, dock, rail): off (your terminal shows through), theme, or a #RRGGBB literal
translation: 未单独设置的界面区域（窗格、桌面、窗口边框、停靠栏、侧边栏）的背景：off（透出终端背景）、theme 或 #RRGGBB 色值

source: Background under pane borders, title bars and the lines between shared-border panes: off, theme, or a #RRGGBB literal; empty follows appearance.background
translation: 窗格边框、标题栏和共用边框分隔线的背景：off、theme 或 #RRGGBB 色值；留空则沿用 appearance.background

source: Background under the dock: off, theme, or a #RRGGBB literal; empty follows appearance.background
translation: 停靠栏背景：off、theme 或 #RRGGBB 色值；留空则沿用 appearance.background

source: Background under the rail: off, theme, or a #RRGGBB literal; empty follows appearance.background
translation: 侧边栏背景：off、theme 或 #RRGGBB 色值；留空则沿用 appearance.background

source: Bar colour: quiet, border, muted, or a #RRGGBB literal
translation: 滚动条颜色：quiet、border、muted 或 #RRGGBB 色值

source: Border style drawn around every pane
translation: 所有窗格的边框样式

source: Built-in patterns hints mode looks for: all, none, or names such as url,path,sha
translation: 提示模式查找的内置类型：all、none，或 url,path,sha 等类型名

source: Card corner radius in pixels
translation: 卡片圆角半径，单位为像素

source: Carry the session's colour on every pane border, not only on the rail
translation: 将会话颜色也用于所有窗格边框

source: Carry the third title bar control on a tiled pane, where it toggles the zoom
translation: 平铺窗格保留标题栏的第三个按钮，用于切换聚焦放大

source: Cells a workspace pill's label may span before the pill cuts it (0 draws the whole name and scrolls the strip instead)
translation: 工作区标签的最大列宽，超出则截断（0 显示完整名称并滚动标签栏）

source: Cells of empty ground kept between two neighbouring tiled panes
translation: 相邻平铺窗格之间的空白列数

source: Cells the scrolling layout's strip moves per mouse wheel event
translation: 滚动布局中，每次鼠标滚轮操作移动的列数

source: Chrome glyph set: the characters the border, controls, rules and rail marks are drawn with
translation: 界面字符样式：用于绘制边框、控件、分隔线和侧边栏标记

source: Colour theme name. Empty keeps your terminal's own colours.
translation: 配色主题名称。留空则保留终端自身的颜色。

source: Columns of padding each side of an overlay panel's content
translation: 浮层面板内容左右两侧的留白列数

source: Command that starts a graphical desktop entry instead of a pane. The entry's argv is added to it. Use a command that takes an argv, such as "tuios-wayland launch --" or "niri msg action spawn --". Do not use one that joins its arguments into a shell line, such as "swaymsg exec --" or "hyprctl dispatch exec".
translation: 启动图形桌面应用的命令，应用的 argv 参数会追加其后。请使用接收 argv 的命令，例如 "tuios-wayland launch --" 或 "niri msg action spawn --"；不要使用将参数拼成 shell 命令行的命令，例如 "swaymsg exec --" 或 "hyprctl dispatch exec"。

source: Copy a mouse selection to the clipboard on release
translation: 松开鼠标时将选中文字复制到剪贴板

source: Corner the picture-in-picture view goes to first. It moves to another corner when the cursor enters it
translation: 画中画初始所在的角落。光标进入时会移到另一个角落

source: Corner the which-key popup opens in (empty: bottom-right)
translation: 快捷键提示弹窗的位置（留空为右下角）

source: Count staged, changed and untracked paths in the rail's git section. The only part of it that costs a walk of the working tree.
translation: 在侧边栏的 Git 区域统计已暂存、已修改和未跟踪的路径数。这项统计需要遍历工作树。

source: Ctrl and a label opens the URL or path. It does not open on a remote client
translation: 按住 Ctrl 并输入提示标签可打开 URL 或路径。远程客户端不执行打开操作

source: Cut the beam at its edge, or fade it out. A fade sends about three times the bytes each time the beam moves
translation: 聚光区域边缘直接截断或逐渐淡出。淡出时每次移动发送的数据量约为三倍

source: Default output format for captures
translation: 截图的默认输出格式

source: Detect a pane's foreground agent CLI and set its state glyph
translation: 检测窗格前台运行的智能体命令行程序，并显示其状态标记

source: Dim the panes in the multifocus set like other panes you are not in
translation: 多选集合中的非当前窗格也与其他非当前窗格一样变暗

source: Draw a nerd font icon per file type in the files section
translation: 在文件区域按文件类型显示 Nerd Font 图标

source: Draw a soft shadow under the card
translation: 在卡片下方绘制柔和阴影

source: Draw each file icon in its file type's own colour
translation: 按文件类型为文件图标着色

source: Draw images an app positions with kitty Unicode placeholders: auto, on, off
translation: 显示应用通过 kitty Unicode 占位符定位的图像：auto、on、off

source: Draw one border between neighbouring tiled panes, in every layout
translation: 所有布局中，相邻平铺窗格共用一条边框

source: Draw pane images as block glyphs when the terminal has no graphics: auto, octant, sextant, quadrant, half, off
translation: 终端不支持图形时，用块状字符显示窗格图像：auto、octant、sextant、quadrant、half、off

source: Draw rounded caps on every dock pill: the mode chip, the workspace tabs and the minimized windows. Off draws flat pills
translation: 为停靠栏中的模式标记、工作区标签和最小化窗口绘制圆角端部。关闭则使用平直端部

source: Draw selected text bold as well as tinted
translation: 所选文字除着色外也加粗显示

source: Draw the cursor cell in the capture
translation: 截图中显示光标

source: Draw the dock as one row with no rule. The panes get one more row
translation: 停靠栏仅占一行且不绘制分隔线，为窗格多留一行

source: Dressing around the capture: a window card, a plain card, or nothing
translation: 截图外框：窗口卡片、普通卡片或无外框

source: Edge of the pane the title is drawn on
translation: 窗格标题显示在哪条边

source: Edge the dock sits on, or hidden
translation: 停靠栏所在的边缘，或隐藏

source: Edge the rail sits on, or hidden
translation: 侧边栏所在的边缘，或隐藏

source: Edge the session rail sits on
translation: 会话侧边栏所在的边缘

source: Focus the pane under the cursor as the mouse moves
translation: 鼠标移动时，将焦点移到光标下的窗格

source: Folder where capture files are saved
translation: 截图文件的保存目录

source: Font file to draw PNG with, also embedded in SVG and HTML.
translation: 绘制 PNG 使用的字体文件，也会嵌入 SVG 和 HTML。

source: Font to draw the capture in when your terminal does not say which it uses
translation: 终端未提供字体信息时，截图使用的字体

source: Give each session its own colour on the rail and in the switcher
translation: 在侧边栏和切换器中为各会话分配不同颜色

source: Go time layout the clock is drawn with, e.g. 15:04 or Mon 3:04PM
translation: 时钟使用的 Go 时间格式，例如 15:04 或 Mon 3:04PM

source: Go time layout the clock renders in (empty means
translation: 时钟使用的 Go 时间格式（留空表示

source: Hairline thumb over the content column, or a full-height track
translation: 叠在内容列上的细滑块，或贯穿高度的滚动轨道

source: Half the beam's height, in rows
translation: 聚光区域高度的一半，单位为行

source: Hand the zoom to the pane the focus lands on, so moving focus while zoomed shows the pane you moved to
translation: 聚焦放大跟随焦点移动，始终显示当前获得焦点的窗格

source: Height of the picture-in-picture view, border included, in cells
translation: 画中画高度，包含边框，单位为行

source: Height of the scratch terminal, in cells (20) or percent (80%)
translation: 临时终端高度，可用行数（20）或百分比（80%）表示

source: Hex colour overriding an unfocused pane's border, e.g. #585b70
translation: 非当前窗格边框的十六进制颜色，例如 #585b70

source: Hex colour overriding the focused pane's border, e.g. #89b4fa
translation: 当前窗格边框的十六进制颜色，例如 #89b4fa

source: Hide the clock overlay
translation: 隐藏时钟浮层

source: Hide the minimize, maximize and close buttons
translation: 隐藏最小化、最大化和关闭按钮

source: Hide the scrollbar thumb on the pane border
translation: 隐藏窗格边框上的滚动条滑块

source: Highest a column's width may be set to in the scrolling layout, as a percent. 100 lets a column fill the screen, at the cost of the next one peeking in at the edge.
translation: 滚动布局中列宽的最大百分比。100 可让一列占满屏幕，但屏幕边缘将看不到下一列的预览。

source: Highest frame rate tuios draws at. Your terminal and monitor can show fewer frames.
translation: tuios 绘制画面的帧率上限。终端和显示器实际能显示的帧率可能更低。

source: Hours when nothing alerts. Write it as HH:MM-HH:MM.
translation: 停止所有提醒的时段，格式为 HH:MM-HH:MM。

source: How an alert sounds: a cue, a BEL, or both
translation: 提醒发声方式：提示音、BEL 终端响铃或两者同时

source: How long an agent row rests (idle, unknown, or done and seen) before the rail folds it into one line: a duration such as 1h, or off
translation: 智能体处于休息状态（空闲、未知，或已完成且已查看）多久后，侧边栏将其折叠为一行：例如 1h，或 off

source: How many panes are master panes in the master-stack layout
translation: 主从布局中主窗格的数量

source: How many yanks to keep to paste again. When it is full, the oldest goes. 0 keeps none.
translation: 保留多少次复制内容以供再次粘贴。存满后移除最早的内容。0 表示不保留。

source: How much moves: none, basic (window slides and the copy sweep), or full (also overlay fades and the working-agent shimmer)
translation: 动画程度：none、basic（窗口滑动和复制扫光），或 full（另含浮层淡入淡出和智能体工作闪光）

source: How much of the screen a zoomed pane takes, as a percent. Below 100 the layout around it stays visible at the edges.
translation: 聚焦放大的窗格占屏幕的百分比。小于 100 时，边缘仍可看到周围布局。

source: How much the daemon logs
translation: 守护进程的日志详细程度

source: How much the screen behind a modal panel is darkened, as a percent. 0 is off.
translation: 模态面板后方画面的变暗百分比。0 表示关闭。

source: How much tuios fades a pane you are not in, as a percent. 0 is off.
translation: 非当前窗格的变暗百分比。0 表示关闭。

source: How the pane navigator lists the panes when it opens
translation: 窗格导航器打开时的排列方式

source: Icon in the mode pill in terminal mode. An empty value shows no icon. default uses the icon of the glyph set
translation: 终端模式下的模式图标。留空不显示图标，default 使用当前字符样式的图标

source: Icon in the mode pill in window mode. An empty value shows no icon. default uses the icon of the glyph set
translation: 窗口模式下的模式图标。留空不显示图标，default 使用当前字符样式的图标

source: Icon in the mode pill while tiling is on. An empty value shows no icon. default uses the icon of the glyph set
translation: 平铺模式下的模式图标。留空不显示图标，default 使用当前字符样式的图标

source: In the scrolling layout with focus-follows-mouse on, hovering a column that is partly off the edge brings all of it on screen
translation: 滚动布局启用焦点跟随鼠标时，悬停在部分超出屏幕的列上会将整列移入屏幕

source: In the scrolling layout, clicking a column that is partly off the edge brings all of it on screen
translation: 滚动布局中，点击部分超出屏幕的列会将整列移入屏幕

source: It wins over every other font choice.
translation: 它的优先级高于其他所有字体设置。

source: Keys the pane labels are made of, first pane first. Letters a to z and digits
translation: 窗格标签使用的按键，依次分配给各窗格。可用 a 到 z 和数字

source: Label the collapsed strip on hover
translation: 鼠标悬停时显示折叠栏的标签

source: Let the Neovim navigator plugin hand terminal focus keys back to TUIOS
translation: 允许 Neovim 导航插件将终端焦点按键交还给 TUIOS

source: Let the files section create, rename, delete, copy and paste
translation: 允许在文件区域新建、重命名、删除、复制和粘贴

source: Letters the hint labels are made of, easiest first
translation: 提示标签使用的字母，易输入的排在前面

source: Light one part of the screen and dim the rest
translation: 照亮屏幕的一部分，其余区域变暗

source: Lines each pane keeps in its scrollback. A pane takes the value when it is made. The daemon reads it when it starts
translation: 每个窗格保留的终端历史行数。窗格创建时采用此值，守护进程启动时读取此设置

source: Lines scrolled per mouse wheel notch
translation: 鼠标滚轮每格滚动的行数

source: Links the pointer picks up: off, only marked links, or plain URLs too
translation: 鼠标识别的链接：关闭、仅标记链接，或也识别普通 URL

source: Make a bare "tuios" attach to a daemon-backed session instead of running standalone. TUIOS_NO_DAEMON=1 or --standalone overrides it. False when the config file has no [startup] table.
translation: 直接运行 "tuios" 时连接由守护进程管理的会话。TUIOS_NO_DAEMON=1 或 --standalone 可覆盖此设置。配置文件没有 [startup] 表时默认为关闭。

source: Make a mail alert audible. Unset follows notifications.agent.sound.
translation: 收到消息时发声提醒。未设置则沿用 notifications.agent.sound。

source: Make an alert audible
translation: 提醒时发声

source: Make errors wait for esc instead of expiring
translation: 错误通知保持显示，按 esc 才关闭

source: Milliseconds one copy sweep takes
translation: 一次复制扫光动画的时长，单位为毫秒

source: Milliseconds the prefix stays armed after a repeatable command. 0 turns it off.
translation: 执行可重复命令后，前缀键保持激活的毫秒数。0 表示关闭。

source: Minutes of quiet before the screen saver starts
translation: 无操作多少分钟后启动屏幕保护

source: Most KiB all paste buffers hold together, at most 262144 (256 MiB). When it is full, the oldest go. 0 uses 16384.
translation: 所有粘贴缓冲区的总容量上限，单位为 KiB，最高 262144（256 MiB）。存满后移除最早的内容。0 使用 16384。
